title: Job Posting: Plant Operator / Town Maintenance

blocks.text: The Town of Keysville is seeking qualiﬁed candidates to ﬁll a Plant Operator/Town Maintenance position for the Wastewater Utility Plant & Town Maintenance Department. This position will perform work of moderate di iculty in general maintenance and operating the wastewater treatment plant in accordance with applicable laws, ordinances and regulations.
Duties include but not limited to
Preferred (not required) Qualiﬁcations, Special Certiﬁcations and Licenses
 Minimum of Class 3 Virginia Wastewater Works Operator License;

   Candidates without a Virginia Wastewater Operator License will be required to
       obtain Class 4 Wastewater Works Operator License within 9 months of their initial
       hire date.
      Candidate will also be required to obtain Class 3 Wastewater Works License within
       18 months of their initial hire date.
      Tuition reimbursement provided with an executed employment contract.
      Failure to obtain either licensure requirement will result in termination of
       employment.

   Salary range $15 - $20 hourly, depending on experience
      Paid Employee health insurance
      Contribution to Virginia Retirement Systems
      Paid holidays, vacation, personal and sick time
You may drop o applications at the Keysville Town O ice located at 120 J Street, Keysville VA, or email to townmanager@townofkeysville.com

The Town of Keysville provides equal opportunity employment opportunities to all applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, sexual orientation or any other characteristics protected by federal, state or local laws.
